title: Studio Hero
description: An independent design studio’s opening screen with edge-to-edge photography, quiet navigation and an invitation to start a project.
summary: Full-bleed photography, three navigation menus and a single primary action.
notes: Studio is a direct navigation link. Replace the example fragments with your project, service, journal, studio and contact pages.
Desktop menus are native HTML popovers. On mobile a hamburger opens an Actual CSS drawer with native dialog commands and collapsible link groups. Keep the desktop and mobile destinations in sync.

Work shows a different decorative project photo on hover and keyboard focus. Services cards zoom and the action arrow changes sides. Reduced motion disables the zoom, the arrow movement and the hero entrance.

Actual CSS in-view triggers the copy and action’s staggered reveal once. To see it on scroll, open the preview in a short window so the action starts below the fold. Without the runtime, the reveal plays on first render and navigation remains native.
